objective.statement: Select a model or vendor for a workload by comparing candidates pairwise on MEASURED quality, cost and latency - never on asserted reputation.
objective.charter: MANDATE. No vendor choice on vibes. Each axis - quality, cost, latency - must be measured on this workload and cited as a run, and a candidate with an unmeasured axis is not comparable, it is unranked. Candidates are compared pairwise so the ranking is transitive and inspectable rather than a single beauty-contest score. The council seats one generalist from each of two vendors deliberately, so a vendor's own advocate is in the room and cross-vendor disagreement is cheap to surface. Fast unanimity here IS suspicious: agreeing quickly about which vendor is better, before three axes have been measured, is the signature of shared priors rather than shared evidence, and it triggers a blind re-evaluation.
success_criteria: quality, cost and latency each measured on this workload, with the run cited
every pairwise comparison recorded, not just the winner
at least three executable measurement runs passed
fast unanimity triggers a blind re-evaluation rather than an early stop

forbidden_actions: rank a candidate on an unmeasured axis
cite a public benchmark in place of a run on this workload

roster.display_name: Cost analyst - measures cost per unit of the workload

context.briefing: Reject any axis backed by a public leaderboard instead of a run on this workload. Declare what produced each number and what checked it; an undeclared source probe is zero signals, not one.

roster.display_name: Implementer - runs the workload against each candidate
Security - data handling and egress per vendor
Generalist seat, OpenAI vendor - argues its own candidate honestly
Generalist seat, Anthropic vendor - argues its own candidate honestly

sequence.custom_name: measure quality, cost and latency on THIS workload
pairwise candidate comparison on measured axes

stopping.source_expression: custom:quality_measured == true AND custom:cost_measured == true AND custom:latency_measured == true AND experiments_passed >= 3

conditional_decision_requires: the selected candidate is re-measured on the real workload volume

metadata.title: Model / vendor selection jury (advisory)
metadata.notes: SOURCE DESIGN: C-H59 `model-vendor-selection`, global ordinal 59, tier standard, protocols P37/P54, 6 seats, 2 rounds, default binding ADVISORY, anti-sycophancy fast_unanimity->blind_reeval, OWNER-DECISION NO. || EDITABLE DIALS: (1) candidates -> participants.roster generalist seats plus the pairwise-compare stage; add one generalist seat per candidate vendor so each candidate has an advocate under evidence rules. (2) axes -> the three custom:*_measured clauses in stopping.expression and the measure-three-axes stage; if you add a fourth axis, add a fourth clause or the axis is decorative. Secondary dials: topology.tournament.comparisons_per_pair (2), voting.quorum.min_voters (5), budgets.time_minutes (60), diversity.max_share_per_vendor (0.5). || VOCABULARY MAP (design term -> CouncilSpec enum): voting `pairwise_condorcet` -> topology.kind `pairwise_tournament` (round_robin, bradley_terry) plus voting.method `condorcet` and consensus.measure `pairwise_agreement`. roles `cost_analyst` -> custom:cost_analyst, `methodologist` -> custom:methodologist as chair, `implementer` -> custom:implementer, `security` -> security_reviewer (enum) with a safety-only veto, `generalist@codex` and `generalist@claude` -> two domain_expert seats distinguished by the `vendor` field; the schema's role pattern forbids an @ so the vendor cannot live in the role name, and each carries an explicit vendor_interest conflict disclosure. `anti-sycophancy: fast_unanimity->blind_reeval` is the one design row in this lane that is ON: consensus.fast_unanimity_is_suspicious true plus anti_failure.fast_unanimity_response ['blind_re_evaluation','strongest_counterexample','recruit_independent_critic']. speaking_order `lowest_confidence_first` is chosen for the same reason - it stops the most confident seat from anchoring the room. `evidence standard: executable_receipt` -> anchor_style `command_output` plus outputs.receipt_schema. || CUSTOM METRICS AND THEIR PRODUCERS: custom:quality_measured, custom:cost_measured, custom:latency_measured (all boolean; each produced by the measure-three-axes stage and true only when the number came from a run on THIS workload, with the command cited). Producers cannot live on the leaves: SEM-001 compares parse(source_expression) with the tree by dict equality and parse() emits no `producer` key - both-states probe at platform/council/_probe_note_vs_source_expression.py. Three SEM-012 WARNs are expected and non-blocking. || WHY experiments_passed >= 3 IS THE FOURTH CLAUSE: three booleans can be asserted; the registry metric cannot be non-zero unless the run executed something three times. It is the clause that converts 'we measured it' from a claim into a receipt.
